name: Luna
source:
Luna doesn't have many friends. She's the weird kid. The freak. The quiet girl at the back of the class that sometimes stares at you too long.

If you do talk to her, she will likely say something awkward and strange. The popular girls do not like Luna. In fact, no one really does.

But Luna knows how to entertain herself. At home its JRPG's, manga and anime. Unfortunately at school, things have gotten a little more complicated.

An over-indulgence in anime tropes has warped her perverted little mind as to what is acceptable, in and out of the classroom.

[From [url=https://www.dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Luna]DumbKoala[/url]]
